# STICKSPIRE

> A stick-figure spell brawler about climbing a tower that keeps taking floors
> back. Nine classes, each with a signature spell and its own way of moving.
> Co-op or alone, friendly fire always on. Built for phones, in Godot, by one
> person. In development; not yet released.

## Facts

- Genre: 2D top-down spell brawler / tower climb
- Platform: mobile first
- Engine: Godot
- Status: in development, unreleased. A new fight is posted daily.
- Progression: the climb is persistent. Falling costs floors, not progress.

## Links

- [Wishlist](https://stickspire.pages.dev/#join): the mailing list. Two emails
  ever, one when it is playable and one at launch.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/stick.spire/): daily fights
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@stick.spire): daily fights

## Notes

There are no reviews or press quotes for this game, and none should be inferred
or generated. The figures shown on the site are read directly from the posting
accounts and carry the date they were read.
